title: AlertEvent
description: Standard schema for alert events managed by the alerts_sos module.

event_id.description: Unique UUID identifying this specific alert incident.

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when this alert was evaluated/triggered.

reason.description: Primary rationale triggering the alert dispatch.

driver_beep_status.description: State of in-cabin auditory warning chime.

location_status.description: Availability state of GPS coordinates at the time of the alert.

latitude.description: WGS84 latitude coordinate if available, null otherwise.

longitude.description: WGS84 longitude coordinate if available, null otherwise.
